}}
{{recipe|Brownies, Double Chocolate}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Holiday Recipes|Holiday Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==
* ⅓ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Butter|unsalted butter]]
* ¾ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 package (12 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]]) dark or bittersweet [[Cookbook:Chocolate Chips|chocolate chips]], divided in half
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
* ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Flour|all purpose flour]]
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (100 g) standard [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]] 
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Chop|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Nut|nuts]] (optional)

==Procedure==
# Let the eggs and butter sit out for 30 minutes to bring to room temperature.
# Preheat oven to [[wikipedia:oven temperatures|165°C]] (325°F).
# In a small bowl, sift together the flour, baking soda, and salt. Set aside.
# In a small [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] combine butter, sugar, and water. Bring just to a [[Cookbook:Boil|boil]] then remove from heat.
# Add half of the chocolate chips (6 oz) and vanilla. Stir until smooth and shiny.
# Transfer the chocolate mixture into a large bowl.
# Add eggs one at a time, [[Cookbook:Beating|beating]] well after each addition.
# Gradually blend in flour mixture.
# Stir in remaining chocolate chips and nuts if desired.
# Spread in a greased 9-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] square [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|pan]]. 
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 165°C (325°F) for 30–35 minutes.
# Cool completely before cutting into 2¼-inch squares.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==
* Substitute some or all of the flour with [[Cookbook:Whole Wheat Flour|whole-wheat flour]].
* To substantially reduce the fat and cholesterol, substitute the two eggs with three egg whites.
* Substitute the vanilla extract with ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Almond Extract|almond extract]] or 2 teaspoon orange liqueur.
* For a quicker recipe, don't leave the eggs and butter out; instead, soften the butter in the microwave, and do nothing else with the eggs.
